longDescription:
This is a clone of FAR manager for Windows, similar, but more powerful than Norton Commander/Midnight Commander.

Plug-ins that are currently working:

  • align
  • autowrap
  • calc
  • colorer
  • compare
  • drawline
  • editcase
  • editorcomp
  • filecase
  • incsrch
  • inside
  • multiarc
  • NetRocks (SFTP/SCP/FTP/FTPS/SMB/NFS/WebDAV)
  • python
  • SimpleIndent
  • tmppanel
